entities.summary: Adeola Deborah Olubamiji is a Canadian technologist who specializes in metal and plastic additive manufacturing. In 2017, she became the first Black person to obtain a PhD in Biomedical Engineering from the 112-year-old University of Saskatchewan, Canada. She went on to give a TEDx Talk on how she utilized 3D printing for recovery of damaged articular cartilage in Canada.
